name: kimai-mcp-server
description: MCP server for self-hosted Kimai time-tracking instances.
long_description: Connect Claude to your self-hosted [Kimai](https://www.kimai.org) time-tracking instance. 28 tools covering timesheets, customers, projects, activities, tags, users, teams, invoices, expenses, and tasks. 23 tools are read-only; the 5 timesheet write tools (create, update, stop, restart, duplicate) each require explicit authorization fields and save a JSON backup to the OS temp directory before reporting success.

base_url.title: Kimai Base URL
base_url.description: Your Kimai URL without a trailing slash, for example https://example.kimai.cloud

api_token.title: API Token
api_token.description: Generate an API token in your Kimai user profile (API Access)

timeout_ms.title: Request Timeout (ms)
timeout_ms.description: HTTP timeout for Kimai API requests, minimum 1000

tools.name: kimai_get_server_info
tools.description: Kimai version, plugins, and timesheet config

tools.name: kimai_get_current_user
tools.description: The user behind the API token

tools.name: kimai_list_projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by customer

tools.name: kimai_list_activities
tools.description: List activities, optionally filtered by project

tools.name: kimai_create_timesheet
tools.description: Create a timesheet entry (write, requires authorization fields)

tools.name: kimai_update_timesheet
tools.description: Update a timesheet entry (write, requires authorization fields)

tools.name: kimai_stop_timesheet
tools.description: Stop a running timesheet (write, requires authorization fields)

tools.name: kimai_restart_timesheet
tools.description: Restart a stopped timesheet (write, requires authorization fields)

tools.name: kimai_duplicate_timesheet
tools.description: Duplicate a timesheet entry (write, requires authorization fields)
